entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:1
segments: The words of the Preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:2
segments: Vanity of vanities, says the Preacher, vanity of vanities! all [is] vanity.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:3
segments: What [is] the profit to a man in all his labor which he labors under the sun?

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:4
segments: A generation passes away, and a generation comes; but the earth remains forever.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:5
segments: The sun also arises, and the sun goes down, and hurries to its place where it arose.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:6
segments: The wind goes toward the south, and it turns around to the north; it whirls around continually; and the wind returns on its circuits.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:7
segments: All the rivers run into the sea; yet the sea [is] not full; to the place from where the rivers come, there they return again.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:8
segments: All things [are] full of labor; man cannot utter it; the eye is not satisfied with seeing, nor the ear filled with hearing.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:9
segments: That which has been [is] that which shall be; and that which has been done [is] that which shall be done; and [there is] nothing new under the sun.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:10
segments: Is there a thing [of] which it may be said, See, this [is] new? It has already been in days of old, which were before us.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:11
segments: [There is] no memory of former [things], and also of after [things] when he shall be; for neither shall be a remembrance of them with those who will be at the afterwards.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:12
segments: I the Preacher was king over Israel in Jerusalem.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:13
segments: And I gave my heart to seek and search out by wisdom concerning all which is done under the heavens. [It is] a sad task God has given to the sons of men to be humbled by it.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:14
segments: I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and, behold, all [is] vanity and vexation of spirit.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:15
segments: What [is] crooked cannot be made straight; and [that] lacking cannot be numbered.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:16
segments: I spoke within my own heart, saying, Lo, I have become great and have gathered more wisdom than all that have been before me in Jerusalem; yea, my heart has seen much of wisdom and knowledge.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:17
segments: And I gave my heart to know wisdom and to know madness and folly; I know that this also [is] vexation of spirit.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:18
segments: For in much wisdom [is] much grief; and he who increases knowledge increases sorrow.
